data.desc: Algorhythm Holdings, Inc. is a holding company with two primary assets: Azure Holdings and SemiCab Holdings. Azure Energy provides strategic and technical advisory services for renewable biomass power generation infrastructure. Azure launched in 2025 and has already secured equity participation valued at over $220 million in net present value through multiple power plants under development in the US. The Company has significant fee-income consulting revenues under multi-year contracts and is generating growing, positive EBITDA. For additional information, please go to: http://www.azure-energy.co. Algorhythm Holdings, Inc. also owns and operates SemiCab, an AI-enabled logistics software provider. Since 2020, SemiCab has enabled major retailers, brands, and transportation providers to address common supply-chain problems globally.
